title: HubSpot lifecyclestage will not move back to an earlier stage through the API
symptoms: lifecyclestage keeps the later value after an API update
Moving a customer back to lead or subscriber never sticks
cause: Lifecycle stage only moves forward when set by imports, forms, workflows, or the API. Moving it backward requires clearing the value first.
fix: Send two updates: first set lifecyclestage to an empty string, then set the earlier stage. Read the record back to confirm.
apply: await patch({ properties: { lifecyclestage: '' } }); await patch({ properties: { lifecyclestage: 'lead' } });
affected: HubSpot CRM contacts and companies, default lifecyclestage property, as of 2026-10
